title: ACP driver extension acp
description: What the `acp` driver and its flavors (`grok`, `fx`, `kiro`, `antigravity`) pass through from the Agent Client Protocol without a core ARI mapping. Drivers list `{ ns: "acp", version: "1" }` in `capabilities.extensions`. Vendor `_meta` objects arrive as `x:acp.meta` events, session updates the driver has no mapping for arrive as `x:acp.update` events, and `session.ext("acp", method, params)` sends an ACP extension request (a method name starting with `_`) to the agent and resolves with its result.

AcpMetaEventData.description: One vendor `_meta` object as the agent sent it.

protocolVersion.description: The ACP version the connection negotiated, 1 or 2.

method.description: The ACP method of the frame that carried it, for example `session/update`.

source.description: Where in the frame the `_meta` was: `params`, `result`, `update`, `toolCall` or `option`.

nativeEntityId.description: The tool call, message or option id the `_meta` belongs to, when it belongs to one.

AcpMetaEvent.description: Event body that passes a vendor `_meta` object through.

AcpUpdateEventData.description: A `session/update` the driver does not map to a core event, unchanged.

AcpUpdateEvent.description: Event body that passes an unmapped session update through.

AcpExtensionMethod.description: The `method` of `session.ext("acp", method, params)`: an ACP extension method, which starts with `_`.
